toolchain.reflectionMetadata: usage-based runtime mappings; reflection dataflow scan; System.Private.CoreLib dependency-retained (not --root); freestanding NativeFormat dependency anchors; no full reflection rooting

rules.majorApiChange: The user-facing SDK API is the explicit Inu.ApiContract.json command contract plus explicitly exported coding API declarations.
rules.minorApiChange: Do not infer SDK API from C# public visibility.
rules.abi: Kernel/driver/syscall/debug ABI versions are independently versioned.
rules.consumers: Drivers and applications must declare the API/ABI versions they were built against.
rules.driverCapabilities: Drivers declare a maximum privilege set; the kernel issues per-binding grants from discovered device resources and privileged operations require live grants.
rules.subsystemRuntime: Kernel boot validates all formal subsystem contracts against the live implementations before exposing the interactive runtime.
rules.managedRuntime: NoGcBootstrap is an early-boot phase only; x64 kernels must transition through Inu.Runtime.NativeAot after KernelHeap initialization and pass the executable managed conformance gate before continuing startup.
rules.userProcessExecution: Inu x64 user processes use fixed self-contained ELF64 ET_EXEC or PE32+ images, private lower-half paging, package-selected syscall personality/version, native Inu syscall ABI 2.0 structured Get/Set/Event messages, Event(CommandComplete) followed by Set(ProcessControl, PID, Kill), and fail closed on unresolved dependencies, capabilities, PIE/relocations/import resolution, signatures, or ABI-version mismatch.

componentDefinitions.selectionStatus: candidate definitions are not independently selectable
